slot.brief: Sentence where the subject is separated from its verb by an intervening phrase; error is the verb's number agreement.

stem:
In the sentence below, find the part that contains an error in subject–verb agreement.
**(A)** The collection of rare manuscripts
**(B)** in the university library
**(C)** are being catalogued
**(D)** by a team of trained archivists.
options: by a team of trained archivists.

verdicts.working: “Collection” is singular, so “are being catalogued” should be “is being catalogued.”

working:
The subject is the singular noun “collection”; “of rare manuscripts” and “in the university library” are intervening modifiers. The verb should be “is being catalogued,” not “are being catalogued.”

Independent check: “Collection” is singular, so “are being catalogued” should be “is being catalogued.”
solution: The subject is the singular noun “collection”; the intervening phrase “of rare manuscripts” does not affect subject–verb agreement. The verb should be “is being catalogued,” not “are being catalogued.”
